_comment: Every public claim on monogate.org that a Lean theorem is proved, pinned to the artifact that proves it. `npm run predeploy` runs ../../monogate-lean/tools/lean_claims/check_claims.py over it: each claimed theorem must be declared in its file at the pinned revision; the file must compile in its environment, with the toolchain, package revisions and local-import sources exactly as pinned; each theorem's own #print axioms must have no sorryAx and nothing outside allowed_axioms (the footprint observed on 2026-09-12); and every label occurrence in src/ and public/ must be a site below or an exemption with its reason. To make a claim, add it here in the same change as the page text. scripts/check_proofs_page.py reads the monogate-lean pin from `sources`.

labels: files? compile|compiles against mathlib|recompiles every proof
